variant.description: The model slug. Must equal the stem of scripts/hf_cards/<variant>.yaml and docs/models/<variant>.md.

params.description: Exact parameter count, summed from GGUF tensor shapes.

name.description: HF card license_name, for licences with no SPDX id (spdx "other").

link.description: HF card license_link -- URL of the full licence text.

upstream_repo.description: The upstream model this port derives from.

upstream_commit.description: The upstream revision used to produce the published GGUFs, as the 7-character short SHA.

docs_page.description: Filename under docs/models/ of the page that documents this variant: its own page, or the family page whose roll-up lists it. Drives the family roll-ups and the root README index.

published_repo.description: Our GGUF repo. null until published.

languages.description: Languages this port transcribes, in the spellings it advertises.

language_tag_form.description: What the --language argument accepts. Needed because a model can advertise bare codes while validating hints against locales (nemotron rejects the advertised spelling with UNSUPPORTED_LANGUAGE).

language_aliases.description: {advertised spelling: canonical code}, for languages this model names differently from everyone else (whisper says tl and no where others say fil and nb).

benchmark_exceptions.description: Narrow, reviewed exclusions from the repository publication profile. An exception removes only cells matched explicitly here; a free-form statement cannot satisfy a publication gate.

match.description: Cell fields to match. '*' is an explicit wildcard. Accuracy fields are dataset/split/language/quant; speed fields are machine/backend/quant/sample.

encoder_window_s.description: Fixed encoder window, if the architecture has one (whisper 30 s).

long_form_strategy.description: Which bucket in docs/input-limits.md this family falls into.

max_audio_s.description: Usable ceiling, mirroring transcribe_capabilities::max_audio_ms. null = no practical limit.

capabilities.description: What this port supports; every capability is listed on every record so all models render the same table rows. `supported` is read from the GGUF capability surface by sync_capabilities.py, never hand-written; `verified` means we ran it and watched it work, set by the Stage 8 gate.

transcribe.description: Speech to text in the source language.

translate.description: Speech in one language to text in another. Mirrors what the loader reads from stt.translation.target_languages / .pairs.

targets.description: Targets reachable from any supported source. null when the model gates on explicit pairs.

pairs.description: Explicit source->target pairs, when the model accepts only a fixed set. Carried in whichever form stt.translation.pairs uses.

lang_detect.description: Identifies the spoken language without a hint. A model without this needs a separate LID step in front of it.

over.description: The set detection works over. null means the model's full language list.

timestamps.description: Timestamp granularities this port emits, mirroring transcribe_capabilities::max_timestamp_kind. Not always what upstream offers.

streaming.description: Incremental transcription over a live stream; the shipped latency presets are the capability.

lookahead_ms.description: Audio that must be buffered before a chunk's tokens emit. The number a user feels.

diarize.description: Speaker-attributed output. A diarizing model emits turn markup plain references do not contain, so transcription scoring must remove that markup.

markup.description: Literal shape of the attribution, e.g. '[start][Sxx]text[end]'.

batching.description: Explicit parallel run_batch() fast path, byte-identical to single-stream.

punctuation.description: Emits punctuation. Reserved and deferred: absent means not yet determined, which differs from supported:false.

casing.description: Emits mixed case. Reserved and deferred: absent means not yet determined, which differs from supported:false.

itn.description: Inverse text normalisation ('25' rather than 'twenty five'). Reserved and deferred: absent means not yet determined, which differs from supported:false.

filename.description: Cached from the Hub listing and verified against it, not authored.

size_bytes.description: Exact blob size; prose units are a rendering concern.

accuracy_benchmarks.description: Published measurements only, on full dataset splits, one row per dataset/split/language/quant/metric/timestamps/scoring/mode cell. Batch size is recipe metadata; prefer the profile recipe when selecting among runs.

dataset.description: Dataset id as scripts/wer/ingest.py knows it.

split.description: The full split measured. Named and reproducible; never an ad-hoc selection.

language.description: Canonical dataset code, not necessarily the model's own spelling.

language_hint.description: Actual language spelling passed to the runtime. This differs from language for locale-conditioned models and aliases such as tl/fil.

metric.description: CER for zh/yue/ja/ko/th/km/lo/my; der/cpwer for diarization; accuracy for LID.

ci95.description: Bootstrap 95% interval, percent. A null pair when none was produced -- never 0.0.

batch_size.description: Decode batch size. null when the surviving publication does not record it.

timestamps.description: Timestamp mode used while decoding. null when the surviving publication does not record it.

engine_sha.description: transcribe.cpp commit that produced the hypotheses.

measurement_provenance.description: Present only for a pre-profile result migrated from a published table whose original engine SHA is unavailable; never a guessed commit.

errors.description: Error composition. Deletion-heavy means dropping audio; insertion-heavy means hallucinating.

empty_hyp.description: Utterances that returned nothing. A generation failure, not a transcription error.

publication_profile.description: Id of the catalog/_benchmark_profiles.json profile whose sweep produced this row. Names the recipe; absent on rows published before profiles existed.

scoring.description: A scoring step beyond the standard normalizer, e.g. "opencc-t2s" for Traditional-to-Simplified folding of both sides. Rows with a scoring value are a separate result set from the profile cell.

mode.description: Decoding mode for models that publish one metric under several modes (multitalker "kernel" / "masked" cpWER). Rows with a mode are a separate result set.

headline_benchmark.description: Which accuracy row-set the variant publishes as its headline number, the metric column of its doc and HF card; a renderer selects matching accuracy_benchmarks rows, one per quant. batch_size or timestamps may be null as a wildcard for a legacy table with mixed recipes; a null object means no headline column.

speed_benchmarks.description: Published measurements only, one row per quant/sample/machine/backend cell selected by catalog/_benchmark_profiles.json. The profile also owns iteration and warmup counts and thermal preconditions; rows carry the measured identity and result.

machine.description: Canonical machine slug, as scripts/bench/run.py derives it from the CPU model string. One slug per physical machine.

sample.description: Sample id; the set is open, so a new sample means new rows, not a schema change.

sample_duration_s.description: Carried per cell so nothing downstream assumes a fixed sample set or has to look the duration up.

total_ms.description: mel + encode + decode, mean over iters after warmup. null for legacy rows where only rounded xRT survives.

xrt_compute.description: sample_duration_s / total. Stored rather than derived because it is the published figure and must not drift with rounding.

wall_ms.description: End-to-end wall time for the same run, mean over iters after warmup. Carried because the granite audio-LLMs publish wall rather than compute time.

xrt_wall.description: sample_duration_s / wall. Stored, not derived, for the same reason as xrt_compute.

mel_ms.description: Stage split (mel/encode/decode) so a regression is attributable.

engine_sha.description: A perf number without a build is not reproducible.

measurement_provenance.description: Present only for a pre-profile result migrated from a published table whose original engine SHA is unavailable. The stored xRT remains publishable; detailed timing awaits re-benchmarking.

thermal_gated.description: Whether the machine's thermal precondition was met before this block; ungated runs can differ by tens of percent.

publication_profile.description: Id of the profile whose bench run produced this row; it pins iterations, warmup, samples and thermal policy. Absent on rows measured before profile stamping.

capability.description: Shared envelope. `verified` is required when supported is true and omitted otherwise.

supported.description: Whether this port has the capability.

verified.description: Whether we ran it and observed it working. Set by the Stage 8 gate.

note.description: Only where a consumer would otherwise be surprised -- a gap against what upstream advertises, or a caveat on how it behaves.
